description: A group on the fix track: change-of-bank requests sent back from service centres; no numbers given.

members.one_line: Change-of-bank requests come back incomplete from service centres
members.details: Investors bring the form without a cancelled cheque, so the request is sent back and they visit again.

members.one_line: A checklist at the counter would stop repeat visits
members.details: Counter staff could tick a short checklist before accepting a change-of-bank form.
members.fix: A one-page counter checklist for change-of-bank requests.

output.metric: Change-of-bank requests sent back to investors
output.objective: Every change-of-bank request is complete the first time it reaches a service centre.
